items.html: And if, Heaven forbid, it should turn out so, he could afterwards destroy the enemies of Israel. Then the Holy One, blessed be He, in His mercies, illuminated the illumination of the supernal Nukva, and it is the greatness of Mordechai and Esther; and through them Israel was saved from that trouble and greatness, as we shall explain. And this is the matter of Mordechai and his illumination.
